run_segmentation_inference: run semantic segmentation inference on images in a directory using a config and checkpoint file
run_batch_segmentation: run batch segmentation on images listed in a text file and save results to output directory
run_visualization: run segmentation visualization with configurable opacity and save side-by-side comparison images
run_cpu_inference: run segmentation inference on CPU by setting device to cpu and reverting sync batchnorm
run_save_masks: run segmentation and save binary masks and semantic segment IDs as numpy files
